candidate_classification.scientific_interpretation: Temporal fine time-step solve (dt = 2.5e-4 mm, 15,192 elements, 14,021 increments, Exit 0). Confirms exceptional temporal invariance of initial stiffness K0 (137.945936 kN/mm, Delta K0 = +0.0003%), peak reaction force F_max (0.757626 kN, Delta F_max = -0.0201%), and peak displacement u(F_max) (0.005855 mm, Delta u_peak = -0.0427%) across a 4x time-step refinement range (1.0e-3 -> 5.0e-4 -> 2.5e-4 mm). External work exhibits monotonic decrease (W_ext = 2.331892 mJ, -1.16% vs S1), while the implemented phase-field crack-surface functional SDV17 exhibits modest temporal sensitivity (E_frac = 2.248132 mJ, -3.93% vs S1), resulting in a descriptive bookkeeping residual Delta_book = -0.082562 mJ (-3.54% of W_ext).

energy_variable_semantics.SDV17: Implemented phase-field crack-surface / fracture functional (volumetric integration of Gc * (d^2/(2*l0) + l0/2 * |grad d|^2))
energy_variable_semantics.SDV18: Elastic strain energy functional (volumetric integration of g(d)*psi_+ + psi_-)
energy_variable_semantics.W_ext: External boundary work computed via trapezoidal integration of tensile reaction force F = -RF2_RP over displacement u
energy_variable_semantics.Delta_book: Descriptive bookkeeping difference (E_model - W_ext); non-zero residual reflects unmodeled numerical dissipative dynamics without physical violation
